pages.title: quillmark: getting started
pages.snippet: Install quillmark with pip, then render any Markdown file.
pages.html:
quillmark: getting started

quillmark turns Markdown into typeset documents.

Install

Run the following command in your terminal:

pip install quillmark

Render

To render a file to PDF, run quillmark render notes.md --pdf from the directory that holds the file.

You must have a TeX distribution installed. Do not run quillmark as root.
